title: Dispatch: 82uk pocket presence + transition_bonded_summon (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:

Read spell:find-familiar and spell:find-steed in packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json (data.description + data.mechanics.effects[0].transitions) before coding. Do not edit records.json or anything under packages/core/scripts/importers or packages/core/data/rules-packs.

CODE SURVEY (start here):
- packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts: recastBondedSummon (~L5328), findBondedRecastTransition, recordTransitions/changesTo (~L3100), closeActorLinkAtZeroHp + activeActorLinkMatcher (~L3249-3330; model for "close the link, end the effect when it was the last owned creature"), applyCombatClosureToEffects (~L6060; the per-combatant link/target/source rebind to campaign_actor at ~L6297 — factor out what you need, do not duplicate), cleanup seams for release/remove, auditActiveEffectIntegrity / validateActiveEffectDurableState, EFFECT_END_REASONS (use 'dismissed'), appendEvent + the event-kind union.
- packages/core/src/state/encounterCombatants.ts: ActorStatus (~L53), removeCombatantFromPlay / removeCampaignActorFromPlay (~L3013-3130), restoreBondedCampaignActor (~L3148; add expectedPresence 'pocket-dimension' -> new-form, stays pocketed), startEncounterInTxn campaign-actor admission (~L2017-2240: factor the projection of one campaign actor into an active instance into a single internal function used by start_encounter AND the recall), currentActorProjectionId (~L1152: add a newest-row tie-break within one instance), syncCombatantActor (~L2707: never write an absent row onto a pocketed actor), hasActiveBondLink, the campaign-actor update path (~L272: 'pocketed' is engine-owned like 'absent'; refuse it as an explicit status and refuse hp/condition/status edits of a pocketed actor the same way absent is refused), start_encounter admission (refuse a pocketed actor: "it is in its pocket dimension; recall it with transition_bonded_summon trigger action-recall").
- packages/core/src/state/combatantLifecycle.ts: CombatantLifeStatus (do NOT add pocketed there).
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRecastBondedSummon.ts: model for the new tool file; register the new tool wherever recast_bonded_summon is registered (grep the name across packages/core/src and packages/cli; also any tool allowlists/capability lists/prompt tool inventories and tests that enumerate tool names).
- packages/core/data/migrations/: add 0042_*.sql (follow 0039/0041 rebuild style): campaign_actor status CHECK gains 'pocketed'; active_effect_event kind CHECK gains the new kind. Check whether anything else enumerates the migration list or schema version (grep 0041).
- Every consumer of ActorStatus: grep `status === 'absent'` / `'absent'` on campaign actors across packages/core/src and packages/cli (context assembly, formatting, world_query, rests/time sweeps, CLI views). Decide per site whether pocketed behaves like absent (out of play) and say so in your notes.

BEHAVIOUR TO IMPLEMENT (all inside withTransaction; validate before any write; failures leave state untouched):
1. Tool transition_bonded_summon { effectId, spellRef, trigger, side?, faction?, placement? }; trigger enum action-temporary-dismissal | action-recall | action-permanent-dismissal | action-dismissal | action-release. Same preconditions as recastBondedSummon (effect exists, active not suppressed/ended, kind summoning, source_kind spell and source_ref === spellRef, record resolves, exactly one active actor link with campaign_actor_id, actor exists and has zero-hp rule vanish-bonded). Presence: alive->present, pocketed->pocket-dimension, absent->absent, else refuse naming the status. Select the record transition whose trigger matches and whose when.presence includes the presence and when.link is active; none -> refuse naming spell, trigger and presence. availability.kind source-ambiguity -> refuse naming availability.ambiguityId. Execute by the transition's changes, not by spell name:
   a. presence present -> pocket-dimension (familiar temporary dismissal): if the actor has a live combatant in the active instance, take that combatant out of play via removeCombatantFromPlay, rebind its active links/targets/source refs to the campaign actor, and set the actor 'pocketed' with the hp/conditions/rulesRef/lifecycle the combatant had (capture before removal). Out of combat: actor status -> pocketed, everything else unchanged.
   b. presence pocket-dimension -> present (recall): actor -> alive, everything else unchanged. If a combat instance is active, project the actor into it as a NEW combatant row via the factored seam (id `${instance}-${slug(actorId)}`, or the next free `-2`, `-3`...; side/faction from the actor's most recent row in that instance, else `side` arg required, refuse without it; placement from arg). Report the operation (place-in-unoccupied-space within 30 ft) as narrated.
   c. presence present -> absent, link stays active (steed action-dismissal): combatant (if any) out of play via removeCombatantFromPlay + link rebind; actor absent (removeCampaignActorFromPlay out of combat). Effect and link untouched; recast_bonded_summon restore-same-steed then restores it at max HP (existing path — add a test proving that round trip).
   d. link -> none with presence -> absent (familiar permanent dismissal from present/pocket; steed release from present/absent): take the creature out of play (combatant via removeCombatantFromPlay if live in combat; pocketed or alive actor -> absent; absent stays absent), close the actor link (status removed; add a removed_reason value if the schema CHECK needs one), end the effect with reason 'dismissed' when no active actor link remains (through the normal finalize/end path so ledger ordering invariants hold — 'ended' last).
   Record one new effect event per transition (kind e.g. 'presence-transition': spellRef, transitionId, trigger, actor, from, to, combatantLeft?, combatantEntered?). Return effect view + transitionId + actorId + from/to + combatant ids + effectEnded.
2. Ending a bond any other way while the actor is pocketed (end_effect with a release policy, remove_effect_target, combat closure, integrity) must leave it absent, never an unbonded pocketed actor; report it removed. auditActiveEffectIntegrity: report a pocketed actor not held by exactly one active actor link of an active spell-sourced summoning effect.
3. recast_bonded_summon: pocketed -> 'pocket-dimension' presence; reform-pocketed-familiar executes via restoreBondedCampaignActor expectedPresence 'pocket-dimension' + new-form (actor stays pocketed, new form's hp per the 71u1 rule incl. exhaustion maximum). Update its description and the "Pocket presence is not modelled" doc text.
4. Docs: docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md section 6 (new operation bullet, recast bullet update) and section 8 (pocketed vs absent). Tool description must say: spends no action (spend the caster's action with spend_turn_resource in combat); initiative for a recalled familiar is narrated; permanent dismissal after a 0-HP absence is gated; a released/permanently dismissed creature can return only as a new creature from a new cast.

EVIDENCE TESTS (new file packages/core/test/bondedSummonTransitions.test.ts; reuse the fixtures/helpers of the existing recast tests — grep recast_bonded_summon / recastBondedSummon in packages/core/test). Assert identities and exact states, not counts:
- familiar out of combat: dismiss -> pocketed with hp/conditions/exhaustion unchanged; recall -> alive unchanged; start_encounter refuses pocketed; recast while pocketed reforms and stays pocketed.
- familiar in combat: dismiss -> combatant absent, actor pocketed with the combatant's damaged HP, link targets campaign actor; recall in the same instance -> new row `<id>-2` alive with that HP, currentActorProjection is the new row; close the instance -> actor alive with the new row's state (the stale absent row never overwrites); dismiss then close without recall -> actor stays pocketed.
- recall with an active instance and no prior row and no side -> refused; with side -> projected.
- steed: action-dismissal in and out of combat -> absent, link active; then recast restore-same-steed -> alive at max HP. release from present and from absent -> effect ended 'dismissed', actor absent, start_encounter then admits only as a new manifestation.
- familiar permanent dismissal from present and from pocketed -> effect ended, actor absent; from 0-HP absence -> refused naming ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp.
- refusals: wrong trigger for presence (recall while present, dismissal while pocketed, steed temporary dismissal), ruling-sourced bond, suppressed/ended effect, wrong spellRef. Each refusal leaves canonical state unchanged.
- end_effect on a Find Familiar effect while pocketed -> actor absent, not pocketed.
- migration: an existing DB at 0041 migrates and accepts 'pocketed' and the new event kind.

VERIFY: `npm ci` in the worktree first, then `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). All non-skipped tests must pass.
